review:
African wildlife on Megaways, with tumbles and over 200,000 ways to win.

Four to six scatters trigger the bonus, where you choose your trade-off: more spins or higher starting multipliers, from 15 to 23 spins with multipliers up to 10x. Every tumble win in the bonus raises the multiplier by 1x, and three scatters add five more spins, with no limit. Up to 20,000x, 96.5% RTP.
